difficulty_reason: The author constructs modified paired cocharge exponents, proves each symmetrized family is a nonzero irreducible copy, establishes independence and spans the quotient through an elementary-symmetric ideal recursion. The complete higher-Specht and quotient-basis proof is preserved, not merely a graded character equality.
source_scope_note: The selected problem is the exact original Section4 restatement of Theorem1.4 at669--671, under the explicit construction472 for the hook mu=(n-k+1,1^{k-1}) of height k and size n. All paired-cocharge definitions, nonzero irreducible copies, Laurent comparison, independence of modules, intermediate symmetric-ideal quotient basis and full terminal proof673--676 are retained in complete author Sections1--4. The initial overview at138 instead spells mu=(n-k+1,1^k) while also calling it height k; this literal discrepancy is prominently preserved, not corrected or selected as an independent formula. Later future examples are unselected. Exactly22 fixed numerical tableau grids are exact original diagram-only publisher crops, individually bound to literal source cells and positions. Every surrounding general symbolic expression, monomial, definition, proof paragraph and caption remains editable native TeX. No denied package is acquired, no generalized tableau emulation is supplied and no mathematical proof is generated or repaired.
